verdict.rationale: An llms.txt file or agent-oriented docs is a fair thing to ask of a SaaS platform with a public API, so the axis applies. A direct probe returned HTTP 404 for docs.ledgy.com/llms.txt, and nothing in the pack describes agent-oriented documentation. The only API docs are a static GraphQL reference with no schema artifact, which does not count as agent-oriented documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
